author: Craig Dewar
releaseNotes:
v3.3.13
- All drivers now auto-initialize when driver code is updated via HPM
- No longer need to manually click Initialize on each device after updating
- Stream Driver automatically reconnects SSE event stream after code update
- Appliance drivers automatically refresh status and available programs
- Dishwasher: Elapsed program time now calculated locally when appliance doesn't report it
- Stream Driver: Always refreshes device status on reconnect for complete state recovery

v3.3.12
- Stream Driver: Added watchdog to auto-recover silently dead SSE connections
- Stream Driver: If no data arrives for 3 minutes (KEEP-ALIVE comes every ~55s), forces reconnect
- Stream Driver: Fixes appliances stopping to receive real-time events until manual refresh
- Stream Driver: Added message buffer overflow protection
- Stream Driver: Fixed double-processing of SSE events
- Dishwasher: Fixed jsonState showing stale values after status refresh
- Dishwasher: Fixed z_parseActiveProgram not updating jsonState
- After updating, click Initialize on your Stream Driver to activate the watchdog

v3.3.11
- Fixed lastCommandStatus not updating on successful commands (was only showing failures)
- Thanks to user feedback for spotting this behavior!

v3.3.10
- FridgeFreezer: Added support for ChillerLeft, ChillerRight, and FlexCompartment doors
- FridgeFreezer: New contact attributes for all door types (chillerLeftContact, etc.)
- FridgeFreezer: Fixed aggregate contact to include all door types
- Thanks to user feedback for reporting the unhandled door events!

v3.3.9
- FridgeFreezer: Added individual contact attributes (fridgeContact, freezerContact, flexZoneContact)
- FridgeFreezer: Contact attributes use 'open'/'closed' for Rule Machine compatibility
- Allows triggering RM rules on specific compartment doors instead of just 'any door open'

v3.3.8
- Dishwasher: cyclePhase now shows 'Idle' when Ready (was incorrectly showing 'Prewash')
- Dishwasher: activeProgram clears to 'None' when cycle ends (improves automation reliability)
- Dishwasher: RinseAidNearlyEmpty/SaltNearlyEmpty now initialize to 'Off' (visible immediately)
- Dishwasher: Run Initialize to populate consumable attributes on existing installs
- App: Updated setup instructions for current Home Connect Developer Portal
- App: Added Default Home Connect Account for Testing requirement
- App: Added Redirect URI format example

v3.3.6
- Fixed devices not created on first install
- Oven: on/off now starts/stops programs instead of setting power
- Oven: Fixed program key lookup to use API-reported keys
- Oven: Added warnings when setting temp/duration without a program selected
- Hood: Fixed fan speed control for Option-based hoods
- Hood: Added FanControl compatibility (medium-low, medium-high, on)
- Hood: Light brightness 0 now turns off light
- Hood: Added grease filter alert handler
- Improved 409 error messages with user-friendly translations
- Added Actuator capability to all drivers
- Added clear error message when optional HPM driver is missing
